421  void
422  processInheritedEnumValues( ada_base_entity* tydef,
423  SgEnumDeclaration& derivedTypeDcl,
424  AstContext ctx
425  )
426  {
427  //Get the base type
428  ada_base_entity lal_subtype_indication, lal_base_type;
429  ada_derived_type_def_f_subtype_indication(tydef, &lal_subtype_indication);
430  ada_type_expr_p_designated_type_decl(&lal_subtype_indication, &lal_base_type);

433 
434  using BaseTuple = std::tuple<SgEnumDeclaration*, SgAdaRangeConstraint*>;
435 
436  BaseTuple baseInfo = getBaseEnum(derivedTypeDcl.get_adaParentType());
437  SgEnumDeclaration& origDecl = SG_DEREF(std::get<0>(baseInfo));
438 
439  // do not process derivations from Standard.*Char type.
440  // the reason is that the derived enums will have its symbols
441  // injected into the new scope as alias symbols, but for
442  // character based enums, the symbols are not physically present.
443  if ( si::Ada::characterBaseType(origDecl.get_type()) )
444  return;
445 
446  //Get the range of inherited decls
447  ada_base_entity lal_inherited_decl_list;
448  ada_type_decl_f_type_def(&lal_inherited_decl_list, &lal_inherited_decl_list);
449  ada_enum_type_def_f_enum_literals(&lal_inherited_decl_list, &lal_inherited_decl_list);
450  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_inherited_decl_list);
451 
452  // just traverse the IDs, as the elements are not present
453  for(int i = 0; i < count ; ++i){
454  ada_base_entity lal_inherited_decl;
455  if(ada_node_child(&lal_inherited_decl_list, i, &lal_inherited_decl) != 0){
456  //TODO How will this work? It isn't a unique node.
457  SgType& enumty = SG_DEREF(derivedTypeDcl.get_type());
458 
459  //Get the name
460  ada_base_entity lal_defining_name, lal_identifier;
461  ada_enum_literal_decl_f_name(&lal_inherited_decl, &lal_defining_name);
462  ada_defining_name_f_name(&lal_defining_name, &lal_identifier);
463  std::string ident = canonical_text_as_string(&lal_identifier);
464 
465  // \todo name.ident could be a character literal, such as 'c'
466  // since SgEnumDeclaration only accepts SgInitializedName as enumerators
467  // SgInitializedName are created with the name 'c' instead of character constants.
468  SgExpression& repval = getEnumRepresentationValue(&lal_inherited_decl, i, ctx);
469  SgInitializedName& sgnode = mkEnumeratorDecl(derivedTypeDcl, ident, enumty, repval);
470 
471  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, &lal_inherited_decl, ctx);
472  //~ sg::linkParentChild(enumdcl, sgnode, &SgEnumDeclaration::append_enumerator);
473  derivedTypeDcl.append_enumerator(&sgnode);
474  }

532  void
533  setAbstractModifier(SgDeclarationStatement& dcl, ada_base_entity* info)
534  {
535  bool has_abstract = false;
536  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(info);
537  ada_base_entity lal_abstract;
538  switch(kind){
539  case ada_incomplete_tagged_type_decl:
540  {
541  ada_incomplete_tagged_type_decl_f_has_abstract(info, &lal_abstract);
542  ada_node_kind_enum abstract_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_abstract);
543  has_abstract = (abstract_kind == ada_abstract_present);
544  break;
545  }
546  case ada_derived_type_def:
547  {
548  ada_derived_type_def_f_has_abstract(info, &lal_abstract);
549  ada_node_kind_enum abstract_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_abstract);
550  has_abstract = (abstract_kind == ada_abstract_present);
551  break;
552  }
553  case ada_private_type_def:
554  {
555  ada_private_type_def_f_has_abstract(info, &lal_abstract);
556  ada_node_kind_enum abstract_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_abstract);
557  has_abstract = (abstract_kind == ada_abstract_present);
558  break;
559  }
560  case ada_record_type_def:
561  {
562  ada_record_type_def_f_has_abstract(info, &lal_abstract);
563  ada_node_kind_enum abstract_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_abstract);
564  has_abstract = (abstract_kind == ada_abstract_present);
565  break;
566  }
567  case ada_abstract_subp_decl:
568  {
569  has_abstract = true;
570  break;
571  }
572  default:
573  logWarn() << "Node kind " << kind << " in setAbstractModifier has no abstract.\n";
574  }
575  setModifiers(dcl, has_abstract, false, false);
576  }

618  ada_node_kind_enum lal_has_limited_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_limited);
619  bool has_limited = (lal_has_limited_kind == ada_limited_present);
620 
621  ada_private_type_def_f_has_tagged(lal_element, &lal_has_tagged);
622  ada_node_kind_enum lal_has_tagged_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_tagged);
623  bool has_tagged = (lal_has_tagged_kind == ada_tagged_present);
624 
625  setModifiers(dcl, has_abstract, has_limited, has_tagged);
626  break;
627  }
628  case ada_record_type_def:
629  {
630  logKind("ada_record_type_def", kind);
631  ada_base_entity lal_has_abstract, lal_has_limited, lal_has_tagged;
632 
633  ada_record_type_def_f_has_abstract(lal_element, &lal_has_abstract);
634  ada_node_kind_enum lal_has_abstract_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_abstract);
635  bool has_abstract = (lal_has_abstract_kind == ada_abstract_present);
636 
637  ada_record_type_def_f_has_limited(lal_element, &lal_has_limited);
638  ada_node_kind_enum lal_has_limited_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_limited);
639  bool has_limited = (lal_has_limited_kind == ada_limited_present);
640 
641  ada_record_type_def_f_has_tagged(lal_element, &lal_has_tagged);
642  ada_node_kind_enum lal_has_tagged_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_tagged);
643  bool has_tagged = (lal_has_tagged_kind == ada_tagged_present);
644 
645  setModifiers(dcl, has_abstract, has_limited, has_tagged);
646  break;
647  }
648  /* case A_Tagged_Private_Type_Definition:
649  {
650  logKind("A_Tagged_Private_Type_Definition");
651 
652  setModifiers(dcl, def.The_Union.The_Tagged_Private_Type_Definition);
653  break;
654  }*/
655  default:
656  logWarn() << "Unknown type declaration view: " << kind
657  << std::endl;
658  }
659  }

662  void
663  processInheritedElementsOfDerivedTypes(TypeData& ty, SgDeclarationStatement& dcl, AstContext ctx)
664  {
665  ada_base_entity* tydef = ty.definitionStruct();
666 
667  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(tydef);
668 
669  if ( (kind != ada_derived_type_def)
670  )
671  {
672  return;
673  }
674 
675  if (SgTypedefDeclaration* derivedTypeDcl = isSgTypedefDeclaration(&dcl)){
676  processInheritedSubroutines(tydef, *derivedTypeDcl, ctx);
677  } else if (SgClassDeclaration* classTypeDcl = isSgClassDeclaration(&dcl)){
678  processInheritedSubroutines(tydef, *classTypeDcl, ctx);
679  } else if (SgEnumDeclaration* derivedEnumDcl = isSgEnumDeclaration(&dcl)){
680  processInheritedEnumValues(tydef, *derivedEnumDcl, ctx);
681  processInheritedSubroutines(tydef, *derivedEnumDcl, ctx);
682  } else if (SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl* discrTypeDcl = isSgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl(&dcl)) {
683  processInheritedSubroutines(tydef, *discrTypeDcl, ctx);
684  } else {
685  logError() << "Unknown SgNode in processInheritedElementsOfDerivedTypes.\n";
686  }
687  }
688 
690  // \note if the type is eventually an enum, we cannot use derived type for the
691  // intermediate declarations. So before deciding what kind of node
692  // shall be created we need to go to the bottom of derived type chains.
693  SgDeclarationStatement&
694  createOpaqueDecl(const std::string& ident, ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx)
695  {
696  SgScopeStatement& scope = ctx.scope();
697  bool typeview = false;
698  SgDeclarationStatement* res = nullptr;
699 
700  //Get the type def
701  ada_base_entity lal_type_def;
702  ada_type_decl_f_type_def(lal_element, &lal_type_def);
703  ada_node_kind_enum lal_type_def_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_type_def);
704  if(ada_node_kind(lal_element) != ada_incomplete_type_decl && ada_node_kind(lal_element) != ada_incomplete_tagged_type_decl){
705  typeview = (ada_node_is_null(&lal_type_def) == 0);
706  }
707 
708  //Get the type this points to
709  ada_base_entity lal_base_type_decl;
710  ada_base_type_decl_p_full_view(lal_element, &lal_base_type_decl);
711  ada_node_kind_enum lal_base_type_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_base_type_decl);
712 
713  //TODO Needs more testing w/enums
714 
715  if(lal_base_type_kind == ada_task_type_decl){
716  res = &mkAdaTaskTypeDecl(ident, nullptr /* no spec */, scope);
717  } else if(lal_base_type_kind == ada_protected_type_decl){
718  res = &mkAdaProtectedTypeDecl(ident, nullptr /* no spec */, scope);
719  } else if(!typeview || lal_type_def_kind == ada_private_type_def || lal_type_def_kind == ada_derived_type_def){ //If it isn't an access, we need to find the original type to see if it's a type, record, or enum
720  ada_base_entity lal_base_type_def;
721  ada_type_decl_f_type_def(&lal_base_type_decl, &lal_base_type_def);
722  lal_type_def_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_base_type_def); //TODO If this is ada_dervied_type_def, we might need to go further
723 
724  // if the ultimate base type is an enum, the derived type also shall be an enum.
725  // if not an enum, then an intermediate type decl is created.
726  // firstLevelIsDerived is set to indicate if the first level was a derived type
727  const bool firstLevelIsDerived = lal_type_def_kind == ada_derived_type_def;
728 
729  while(lal_type_def_kind == ada_derived_type_def){
730  //If this is a derived type, get the type it is derived from
731  ada_base_entity lal_subtype_indication;
732  ada_derived_type_def_f_subtype_indication(&lal_base_type_def, &lal_subtype_indication);
733  ROSE_ASSERT(!ada_node_is_null(&lal_subtype_indication));
734 
735  logTrace() << "kind = " << ada_node_kind(&lal_subtype_indication)
736  << " hash = " << hash_node(&lal_subtype_indication)
737  << std::endl;
738 
739  ada_type_expr_p_designated_type_decl(&lal_subtype_indication, &lal_base_type_decl);
740  if (!ada_node_is_null(&lal_base_type_decl)) {
741  //Found a case in standard (s-osinte.ads) where the designated_type_decl points to the parent in an infinite loop
742  // So, check to make sure the new base_type_def isn't the same as the old
743  int old_type_def_hash = hash_node(&lal_base_type_def);
744  ada_type_decl_f_type_def(&lal_base_type_decl, &lal_base_type_def);
745  ROSE_ASSERT(!ada_node_is_null(&lal_base_type_def));
746 
747  if(hash_node(&lal_base_type_def) == old_type_def_hash){
748  SgNode& tyrep = getExprType(&lal_base_type_decl, ctx);
749 
750  const bool isEnum = si::Ada::baseEnumDeclaration(isSgType(&tyrep)) != nullptr;
751 
752  lal_type_def_kind = isEnum ? ada_enum_type_def : ada_private_type_def /* anything */;
753  } else {
754  lal_type_def_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_base_type_def);
755  }
756  } else {
757  ada_base_entity lal_name;
758 
759  ada_subtype_indication_f_name(&lal_subtype_indication, &lal_name);
760  SgNode& tyrep = getExprType(&lal_name, ctx);
761 
762  const bool isEnum = si::Ada::baseEnumDeclaration(isSgType(&tyrep)) != nullptr;
763 
764  lal_type_def_kind = isEnum ? ada_enum_type_def : ada_private_type_def /* anything */;
765  }
766  }
767 
768  if(lal_type_def_kind == ada_enum_type_def){
769  res = &mkEnumDecl(ident, scope);
770  } else if((lal_type_def_kind == ada_record_type_def) && !firstLevelIsDerived){
771  SgClassDeclaration& sgnode = mkRecordDecl(ident, scope);
772  if(typeview){
773  setParentRecordConstraintIfAvail(sgnode, &lal_type_def, ctx);
774  }
775  res = &sgnode;
776  } else { //TODO not sure this will work for everything
777  res = &mkTypeDecl(ident, mkOpaqueType(), scope);
778  }
779  } else {
780  logWarn() << "unhandled opaque type declaration: " << lal_type_def_kind
781  << std::endl;
782  res = &mkTypeDecl(ident, mkOpaqueType(), scope);
783  }
784 
785  // \todo put declaration tags on
786  SgDeclarationStatement& resdcl = SG_DEREF(res);
787 
788  if(typeview){
789  setTypeModifiers(resdcl, &lal_type_def);
790  } else if(ada_node_kind(lal_element) == ada_incomplete_tagged_type_decl) {
791  setModifiers(resdcl, false /*abstract*/, false /*limited*/, true /*tagged*/);
792  }
793 
794  return resdcl;
795  }
796

799  ada_base_entity* lal_element,
800  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl& sgnode,

802  bool isPrivate,
803  AstContext ctx
804  )
805  {
806  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, sgdecl, &SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl::set_discriminatedDecl);

818  SgVariableDeclaration&
819  getDiscriminant(ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx)
820  {
821  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
822  if(kind != ada_discriminant_spec){
823  logError() << "getDicriminant called on non discriminant kind " << kind << std::endl;
824  }
825 
826  //Get the ids and type_expr
827  ada_base_entity lal_names, lal_type_expr;
828  ada_discriminant_spec_f_ids(lal_element, &lal_names);
829  ada_discriminant_spec_f_type_expr(lal_element, &lal_type_expr);
830 
831  SgType& basety = getDeclType(&lal_type_expr, ctx);
832  SgInitializedNamePtrList dclnames = constructInitializedNamePtrList( ctx,
833  libadalangVars(),
834  &lal_names,
835  basety,
836  getVarInit(lal_element, &basety, ctx)
837  );
838  SgVariableDeclaration& sgnode = mkVarDecl(dclnames, ctx.scope());
839 
840  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
841 
842  return sgnode;

846  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl&
847  createDiscriminatedDecl(ada_base_entity* lal_element, ada_base_entity* secondary, AstContext ctx)
848  {
849  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
850 
851  // many definitions are handled else where
852  // here we want to convert the rest that can appear in declarative context
853 
854  SgScopeStatement& scope = ctx.scope();
855  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl& sgnode = mkAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl(scope);
856  SgAdaParameterList& params = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_discriminants());
857 
858  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
859 
860  if(!ada_node_is_null(lal_element) && kind == ada_known_discriminant_part)
861  {
862  logKind("ada_known_discriminant_part", kind);
863  //Get the list of discrs
864  ada_base_entity lal_discr_list;
865  ada_known_discriminant_part_f_discr_specs(lal_element, &lal_discr_list);
866 
867  //Iterate over the discrs
868  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_discr_list);
869  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
870  ada_base_entity lal_discr_spec;
871  if(ada_node_child(&lal_discr_list, i, &lal_discr_spec) != 0){
872  params.append_parameter(&getDiscriminant(&lal_discr_spec, ctx));
873  }
874  }
875 
876  } else if(secondary != nullptr && !ada_node_is_null(secondary)){
877  //TODO Check if this works for secondary discrs
878  int count = ada_node_children_count(secondary);
879  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
880  ada_base_entity lal_discr_spec;
881  if(ada_node_child(secondary, i, &lal_discr_spec) != 0){
882  params.append_parameter(&getDiscriminant(&lal_discr_spec, ctx));
883  }
884  }
885  } else {
886  logWarn() << "createDiscriminatedDecl given non-discr kind " << kind << std::endl;
887  }
888 
889  return sgnode;
890  }

903  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl*
904  createDiscriminatedDecl_opt(ada_base_entity* primary, ada_base_entity* secondary, AstContext ctx)
905  {
906  if(primary == nullptr || ada_node_is_null(primary))
907  {
908  if(secondary != nullptr && !ada_node_is_null(secondary)) logFlaw() << "Unexpected secondary discriminants" << std::endl;

917  SgDeclarationStatement&
918  handleOpaqueTypes( ada_base_entity* lal_element, //Should be an ada_type_decl
919  bool isPrivate,
920  AstContext ctx
921  )
922  {
923  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
924 
925  //Get the name for this type
926  ada_base_entity lal_identifier, lal_defining_name;
927  ada_base_type_decl_f_name(lal_element, &lal_defining_name);
928  ada_defining_name_f_name(&lal_defining_name, &lal_identifier);
929  std::string ident = getFullName(&lal_identifier);
930 
931  //Get the discriminants
932  ada_base_entity lal_discr;
933  if(kind == ada_incomplete_type_decl || kind == ada_incomplete_tagged_type_decl){
934  ada_incomplete_type_decl_f_discriminants(lal_element, &lal_discr);
935  } else {
936  ada_type_decl_f_discriminants(lal_element, &lal_discr);
937  }
938  ada_base_entity* second_discr = secondaryDiscriminants(lal_element, &lal_discr, ctx);
939 
940  //Get the type def
941  ada_base_entity lal_type_def;
942  ada_type_decl_f_type_def(lal_element, &lal_type_def);
943  ada_node_kind_enum lal_type_def_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_type_def);
944 
945  SgScopeStatement* parentScope = &ctx.scope();
946  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl* discr = createDiscriminatedDecl_opt(&lal_discr, second_discr, ctx);
947 
948  if(discr) {
949  parentScope = discr->get_discriminantScope();
950  }
951 
952  SgScopeStatement& scope = SG_DEREF(parentScope);
953  SgDeclarationStatement& sgdecl = createOpaqueDecl(ident, lal_element, ctx.scope(scope));
954  SgDeclarationStatement* assocdecl = nullptr;
955 
956  attachSourceLocation(sgdecl, lal_element, ctx);
957  privatize(sgdecl, isPrivate);
958  int hash = hash_node(lal_element);
959  int decl_hash = hash_node(&lal_defining_name);
960  recordNode(libadalangTypes(), hash, sgdecl);
961  recordNode(libadalangTypes(), decl_hash, sgdecl);
962 
963  if(!discr) {
964  ctx.appendStatement(sgdecl);
965  assocdecl = &sgdecl;
966  } else {
967  completeDiscriminatedDecl(hash, lal_element, *discr, sgdecl, isPrivate, ctx);
968  assocdecl = discr;
969  }
970 
971  //If this is a derived type, get the inherited elements
972  //TODO Other lal_type_def_kinds may still inherit?
973  if(!ada_node_is_null(&lal_type_def) && lal_type_def_kind == ada_derived_type_def){
974  SgDeclarationStatement* tydcl = discr ? discr : &sgdecl;
975 
976  TypeData ty = getTypeFoundation(ident, &lal_type_def, ctx);
977 
978  processInheritedElementsOfDerivedTypes(ty, *tydcl, ctx);
979  }
980 
981  return SG_DEREF(assocdecl);
982  }

993  SgExpression*
994  createInit(SgInitializedNamePtrList& lst, SgExpression* exp)
995  {
996  // the first variable declarations gets the original initializer
997  if ((exp == nullptr) || lst.empty()) return exp;
998 
999  // \todo consider rebuilding from the ASIS expression
1000  exp = si::deepCopy(exp);
1001 
1002  // \todo use a traversal to set all children nodes to compiler generated
1003  markCompilerGenerated(SG_DEREF(exp));

1014  SgInitializedNamePtrList
1015  constructInitializedNamePtrList( AstContext ctx,
1016  map_t<int, SgInitializedName*>& m,
1017  ada_base_entity* lal_name_list,
1018  SgType& dcltype,
1019  SgExpression* initexpr,
1020  std::vector<int>& secondaries
1021  )
1022  {
1023  SgInitializedNamePtrList lst;
1024 
1025  if(ada_node_is_null(lal_name_list)){
1026  //Add a dummy blank name to the list & return
1027  const std::string name = "";
1028  SgExpression* init = createInit(lst, initexpr);
1029  SgInitializedName& dcl = mkInitializedName(name, dcltype, init);
1030  //attachSourceLocation(dcl, &lal_obj, ctx);
1031  lst.push_back(&dcl);
1032  return lst;
1033  }
1034 
1035  int count = ada_node_children_count(lal_name_list);
1036  //Iterate over the list of defining names
1037  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
1038  {
1039  ada_base_entity lal_obj;
1040 
1041  if (ada_node_child(lal_name_list, i, &lal_obj) == 0){
1042  logError() << "Error while getting a child in constructInitializedNamePtrList.\n";
1043  return lst;
1044  }
1045  if(!ada_node_is_null(&lal_obj)){
1046  //Get the name of this decl
1047  ada_base_entity lal_identifier;
1048  ada_defining_name_f_name(&lal_obj, &lal_identifier);
1049  const std::string name = canonical_text_as_string(&lal_identifier);
1050  SgExpression* init = createInit(lst, initexpr);
1051  SgInitializedName& dcl = mkInitializedName(name, dcltype, init);
1052 
1053  attachSourceLocation(dcl, &lal_obj, ctx);
1054 
1055  lst.push_back(&dcl);
1056  int hash = hash_node(&lal_obj);
1057  recordNonUniqueNode(m, hash, dcl, true /* overwrite existing entries if needed */);
1058 
1059  //~ logError() << name << " = " << id << std::endl;
1060 
1061  if (!secondaries.empty())
1062  {
1063  //~ logError() << name << "' = " << secondaries.back() << std::endl;
1064  recordNonUniqueNode(m, secondaries.back(), dcl, true /* overwrite existing entries if needed */);
1065  secondaries.pop_back();
1066  }
1067  }
1068  }
1069 
1070  return lst;
1071  }
1072 
1073  SgInitializedNamePtrList
1074  constructInitializedNamePtrList( AstContext ctx,
1075  map_t<int, SgInitializedName*>& m,
1076  ada_base_entity* lal_name_list,
1077  SgType& dcltype,
1078  SgExpression* initexpr
1079  )
1080  {
1081  std::vector<int> dummy;
1082 
1083  return constructInitializedNamePtrList(ctx, m, lal_name_list, dcltype, initexpr, dummy);
1084  }

1088  SgTypeModifier
1089  getMode(ada_base_entity* lal_mode)
1090  {
1091  //Get the kind of this node
1092  ada_node_kind_enum kind;
1093  kind = ada_node_kind(lal_mode);
1094 
1095  SgTypeModifier res;
1096 
1097  switch(kind)
1098  {
1099  case ada_mode_default:
1100  Libadalang_ROSE_Translation::logKind("ada_mode_default", kind);
1101  res.setDefault();
1102  break;
1103 
1104  case ada_mode_in:
1105  Libadalang_ROSE_Translation::logKind("ada_mode_in", kind);
1106  res.setIntent_in();
1107  break;
1108 
1109  case ada_mode_out:
1110  Libadalang_ROSE_Translation::logKind("ada_mode_out", kind);
1111  res.setIntent_out();
1112  break;
1113 
1114  case ada_mode_in_out:
1115  Libadalang_ROSE_Translation::logKind("ada_mode_in_out", kind);
1116  res.setIntent_inout();
1117  break;
1118 
1119  default:
1120  logWarn() << "Unknown mode " << kind << " in getMode.\n";
1121  break;
1122  }
1123 
1124  return res;
1125  }

1130  SgExpression*
1131  getVarInit(ada_base_entity* lal_decl, SgType* /*expectedType*/, AstContext ctx)

1145  } else if(kind == ada_number_decl){
1146  ada_number_decl_f_expr(lal_decl, &default_expr);

1148  ada_discriminant_spec_f_default_expr(lal_decl, &default_expr);

1150  logWarn() << "getVarInit called with unhandled kind: " << kind << std::endl;
1151  return nullptr;

1153

1155  return nullptr;
1156  }

1179 namespace {
1182  SgClassDeclaration&
1183  createRecordDecl( const std::string& name,
1184  SgClassDefinition& def,
1185  SgScopeStatement& scope,
1186  SgDeclarationStatement* nondefdcl
1187  )
1188  {
1189  if(SgClassDeclaration* recdcl = isSgClassDeclaration(nondefdcl)){
1190  return mkRecordDecl(*recdcl, def, scope);
1191  }
1192 
1193  // if nondefdcl is set, it must be a SgClassDeclaration
1194  if(nondefdcl){
1195  logFlaw() << name << " is " << typeid(*nondefdcl).name() << ", not a class declaration!"
1196  << std::endl;
1197  }
1198 
1199  return mkRecordDecl(name, def, scope);
1200  }

1202  // returns a function declaration statement for a declaration statement
1203  // checks if the function is an Ada generic function, where the declaration
1204  // is hidden under an SgAdaGenericDecl.
1205  SgFunctionDeclaration* getFunctionDeclaration(SgDeclarationStatement* dcl)
1206  {
1207  // PP: 2/6/22 refactored function out of handleDeclaration
1208  if (SgFunctionDeclaration* fndcl = isSgFunctionDeclaration(dcl))
1209  return fndcl;
1210 
1211  // MS: 7/26/2021 This point may be reached for both regular and
1212  // generic subprograms. If it is a generic subprogram that was
1213  // declared, then we'll need to get the declaration out of the
1214  // SgAdaGenericDecl node.
1215  if (SgAdaGenericDecl* generic = isSgAdaGenericDecl(dcl))
1216  return isSgFunctionDeclaration(generic->get_declaration());
1217 
1218  return nullptr;
1219  }

1228  return isSgAdaPackageSpecDecl(generic->get_declaration());

1230  return nullptr;

1361  SgDeclarationStatement&
1362  handleNumVarCstDecl( ada_base_entity* lal_element,
1363  AstContext ctx,
1364  bool isPrivate,
1365  SgType& dclType,
1366  SgType* expectedType = nullptr
1367  )
1368  {
1369  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
1370  //Get the list of defining names
1371  ada_base_entity ids;
1372  SgScopeStatement& scope = ctx.scope();
1373  if(kind == ada_object_decl){
1374  ada_object_decl_f_ids(lal_element, &ids);
1375  } else if(kind == ada_component_decl){
1376  ada_component_decl_f_ids(lal_element, &ids);
1377  } else if(kind == ada_number_decl){
1378  ada_number_decl_f_ids(lal_element, &ids);
1379  }
1380  //
1381  // https://www.adaic.com/resources/add_content/standards/05rm/html/RM-3-3-1.html#S0032
1382  // $7: Any declaration that includes a defining_identifier_list with more than one defining_identifier
1383  // is equivalent to a series of declarations each containing one defining_identifier from the list,
1384  // with the rest of the text of the declaration copied for each declaration in the series, in the
1385  // same order as the list. The remainder of this International Standard relies on this equivalence;
1386  // explanations are given for declarations with a single defining_identifier.
1387  // => clone the initializing expression instead of creating references to the first one..
1388  SgInitializedNamePtrList dclnames = constructInitializedNamePtrList( ctx,
1389  libadalangVars(),
1390  &ids,
1391  dclType,
1392  getVarInit(lal_element, expectedType, ctx)
1393  );
1394 
1395  SgVariableDeclaration& sgnode = mkVarDecl(dclnames, scope);
1396 
1397  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
1398  privatize(sgnode, isPrivate);
1399  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
1400 
1401  return sgnode;
1402  }

1409

1414  SgDeclarationStatement&
1415  handleVarCstDecl( ada_base_entity* lal_element,
1416  AstContext ctx,
1417  bool isPrivate,
1418  TypeModifierFn constMaker
1419  )
1420  {
1421  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
1422  SgType& basety = constMaker(getVarType(lal_element, ctx));
1423 
1424  //Get the aliased status
1425  ada_base_entity has_aliased;
1426  if(kind == ada_object_decl){
1427  ada_object_decl_f_has_aliased(lal_element, &has_aliased);
1428  } else if(kind == ada_component_decl){
1429  ada_component_decl_f_component_def(lal_element, &has_aliased);
1430  ada_component_def_f_has_aliased(&has_aliased, &has_aliased);
1431  }
1432  ada_node_kind_enum aliased_status = ada_node_kind(&has_aliased);
1433  const bool aliased = (aliased_status == ada_aliased_present);
1434  SgType& varty = aliased ? mkAliasedType(basety) : basety;
1435 
1436  return handleNumVarCstDecl(lal_element, ctx, isPrivate, varty);
1437  }

1692  void createCaseStmtPath(ada_base_entity* lal_element, SgSwitchStatement& caseNode, AstContext ctx)
1693  {
1694  //Get the choices
1695  ada_base_entity lal_choices;
1696  ada_case_stmt_alternative_f_choices(lal_element, &lal_choices);
1697 
1698  //Get the stmts
1699  ada_base_entity lal_stmts;
1700  ada_case_stmt_alternative_f_stmts(lal_element, &lal_stmts);
1701 
1702 
1703  SgStatement* sgnode = nullptr;
1704  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
1705 
1706  //Handle the choices
1707  int num_choices = ada_node_children_count(&lal_choices);
1708 
1709  //Check if this is a when others choice
1710  bool when_others = false;
1711  if(num_choices == 1){
1712  ada_base_entity lal_solo_choice;
1713  ada_node_child(&lal_choices, 0, &lal_solo_choice);
1714  ada_node_kind_enum lal_solo_choice_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_solo_choice);
1715  when_others = (lal_solo_choice_kind == ada_others_designator);
1716  }
1717 
1718  if(when_others){
1719  SgDefaultOptionStmt* whenOthersNode = &mkWhenOthersPath(block);
1720 
1721  caseNode.append_default(whenOthersNode);
1722  sgnode = whenOthersNode;
1723  } else {
1724  //If this isn't a "when others", get the options for ths path
1725  std::vector<SgExpression*> choices;
1726  for(int i = 0; i < num_choices; ++i){
1727  ada_base_entity lal_choice;
1728  if(ada_node_child(&lal_choices, i, &lal_choice) !=0){
1729  ada_node_kind_enum lal_choice_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_choice);
1730  if(lal_choice_kind == ada_bin_op){ //TODO Is this right? What makes a def vs an expr?
1731  choices.push_back(&getDefinitionExpr(&lal_choice, ctx));
1732  } else {
1733  choices.push_back(&getExpr(&lal_choice, ctx));
1734  }
1735  }
1736  }
1737 
1738  // \todo reconsider the "reuse" of SgCommaOp
1739  // SgCommaOp is only used to separate discrete choices in case-when
1740  SgExpression& caseCond = mkChoiceExpIfNeeded(std::move(choices));
1741  SgCaseOptionStmt* whenNode = &mkWhenPath(caseCond, block);
1742 
1743  caseNode.append_case(whenNode);
1744  sgnode = whenNode;
1745  }
1746 
1747  //Handle the stmts
1748  int num_stmts = ada_node_children_count(&lal_stmts);
1749  for(int i = 0; i < num_stmts; ++i){
1750  ada_base_entity lal_stmt;
1751  if(ada_node_child(&lal_stmts, i, &lal_stmt) != 0){
1752  handleStmt(&lal_stmt, ctx.scope(block));
1753  }
1754  }
1755 
1756  attachSourceLocation(*sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
1757  }
1758 
1760  void ifStmtCommonBranch(ada_base_entity* lal_path, SgIfStmt* ifStmt, AstContext ctx, void (SgIfStmt::*branchSetter)(SgStatement*))
1761  {
1762  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
1763 
1764  sg::linkParentChild(SG_DEREF(ifStmt), static_cast<SgStatement&>(block), branchSetter);
1765

1767  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
1768  ada_base_entity lal_stmt;
1769  if(ada_node_child(lal_path, i, &lal_stmt) != 0){
1770  handleStmt(&lal_stmt, ctx.scope(block));
1771  }
1772  }
1773  }

1787  // MS 11/17/2020 : SelectStmtCreator modeled on IfStmtCreator
1788  // PP 10/12/2021 : modified code to eliminate the need for using scope_npc.
1789  // A block will only be populated after the new node has been connected
1790  // to the AST. This is achieved by returning a lambda function w/o parameters
1791  // (DeferredBodyCompletion) that is invoked after the node has been connected
1792  // to the AST.
1793 
1794  SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt* handleOrAlternative(SgAdaSelectStmt& sgnode, SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt* currOrPath, ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx){
1795  // create body of alternative
1796  SgBasicBlock* block = &mkBasicBlock();
1797 
1798  //Get the guard
1799  ada_base_entity lal_guard;
1800  ada_select_when_part_f_cond_expr(lal_element, &lal_guard);
1801  SgExpression& guard = getExpr_opt(&lal_guard, ctx);
1802 
1803  // instantiate SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt node
1804  SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt& stmt = mkAdaSelectAlternativeStmt(guard, *block);
1805 
1806  if(currOrPath == nullptr)
1807  {
1808  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, stmt, &SgAdaSelectStmt::set_or_path);
1809  }
1810  else
1811  {
1812  sg::linkParentChild(*currOrPath, stmt, &SgAdaSelectAlternativeStmt::set_next);
1813  }
1814 
1815  //Get the list of stmts & handle them
1816  ada_base_entity lal_stmt_list;
1817  ada_select_when_part_f_stmts(lal_element, &lal_stmt_list);
1818  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_stmt_list);
1819  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
1820  ada_base_entity lal_stmt;
1821  if(ada_node_child(&lal_stmt_list, i, &lal_stmt) != 0){
1822  handleStmt(&lal_stmt, ctx.scope(*block));
1823  }
1824  }
1825 
1826  return &stmt; //Return the stmt so it can be used as the parent for the next or path if necessary
1827  }

1900  void createInheritedSymbol(ada_base_entity* lal_element, SgNamedType& baseType, SgNamedType& derivedType, AstContext ctx)
1901  {
1902  logTrace() << "In createInheritedSymbol\n";
1903  int hash = hash_node(lal_element);
1904  SgDeclarationStatement* fndcl = findFirst(libadalangDecls(), hash);
1905  SgFunctionDeclaration* fn = isSgFunctionDeclaration(fndcl);
1906 
1907  if (fn == nullptr)
1908  {
1909  logFlaw() << "unable to find function with hash " << hash << std::endl;
1910  return;
1911  }
1912 
1913  SgFunctionSymbol* fnsym = findFirst(inheritedSymbols(), std::make_pair(fn, &baseType));
1914  if (fnsym == nullptr) fnsym = isSgFunctionSymbol(fn->search_for_symbol_from_symbol_table());
1915 
1916  if (fnsym == nullptr)
1917  {
1918  logFlaw() << "unable to find (derived) function symbol for " << fn->get_name() << std::endl;
1919  return;
1920  }
1921 
1922  SgDeclarationStatement const* symdcl = fnsym->get_declaration();
1923  if (symdcl && (symdcl->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration() != fn->get_firstNondefiningDeclaration()))
1924  {
1925  logFlaw() << fn->get_name() << " sym/dcl mismatch"
1926  << std::endl;
1927  }
1928 
1929  SgAdaInheritedFunctionSymbol& sgnode = mkAdaInheritedFunctionSymbol(*fnsym, derivedType, ctx.scope());
1930  const auto inserted = inheritedSymbols().insert(std::make_pair(InheritedSymbolKey{fn, &derivedType}, &sgnode));
1931 
1932  ROSE_ASSERT(inserted.second);
1933  }

1936  int getLabelRef(ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx)
1937  {
1938  logTrace() << "In getLabelRef()\n";
1939  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
1940 
1941  if(kind == ada_dotted_name)
1942  {
1943  logKind("ada_dotted_name", kind);
1944  //Get the suffix
1945  ada_base_entity lal_suffix;
1946  ada_dotted_name_f_suffix(lal_element, &lal_suffix);
1947  return getLabelRef(&lal_suffix, ctx);

1950  logKind("ada_identifier", kind);
1951  ada_base_entity lal_label_decl;
1952  ada_expr_p_first_corresponding_decl(lal_element, &lal_label_decl);
1953  if(ada_node_is_null(&lal_label_decl)){
1954  //Try p_referenced_decl instead
1955  ada_name_p_referenced_decl(lal_element, 1, &lal_label_decl);
1956  }

1965 SgVariableDeclaration&
1966 getParm(ada_base_entity* lal_param_spec, AstContext ctx)
1967 {
1968  logTrace() << "getParm called\n";
1969 
1970  ada_base_entity defining_name_list;
1971  ada_param_spec_f_ids(lal_param_spec, &defining_name_list);
1972 
1973  ada_base_entity has_aliased;
1974  ada_param_spec_f_has_aliased(lal_param_spec, &has_aliased);
1975  ada_node_kind_enum aliased_status = ada_node_kind(&has_aliased);
1976  const bool aliased = (aliased_status == ada_aliased_present);
1977 
1978  //Get the type of this parameter
1979  ada_base_entity subtype_indication;
1980  ada_param_spec_f_type_expr(lal_param_spec, &subtype_indication);
1981  SgType& basety = getDeclType(&subtype_indication, ctx);
1982 
1983  SgType& parmtype = aliased ? mkAliasedType(basety) : basety;
1984 
1985  SgInitializedNamePtrList dclnames = constructInitializedNamePtrList( ctx,
1986  libadalangVars(),
1987  &defining_name_list,
1988  parmtype,
1989  getVarInit(lal_param_spec, &parmtype, ctx)
1990  );
1991 
1992  ada_base_entity mode;
1993  ada_param_spec_f_mode(lal_param_spec, &mode);
1994  SgVariableDeclaration& sgnode = mkParameter(dclnames, getMode(&mode), ctx.scope());
1995 
1996  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_param_spec, ctx);
1997 
1998  return sgnode;
1999 }

2002 void ParameterCompletion::operator()(SgFunctionParameterList& lst, SgScopeStatement& parmscope)
2003 {
2004  if(!ada_node_is_null(range)){
2005  ada_node_kind_enum range_kind = ada_node_kind(range);
2006  ada_base_entity param_list;
2007  if(range_kind == ada_params){
2008  ada_params_f_params(range, &param_list);
2009  } else if(range_kind == ada_entry_completion_formal_params){
2010  ada_entry_completion_formal_params_f_params(range, &param_list);
2011  }
2012 
2013  int count = ada_node_children_count(&param_list);
2014  for (int i = 0; i < count; ++i)
2015  {
2016  ada_base_entity child;
2017 
2018  if(ada_node_child(&param_list, i, &child) == 0){
2019  logError() << "Error while getting a child in ParameterCompletion.\n";
2020  return;
2021  }
2022  if(!ada_node_is_null(&child)){
2023  SgVariableDeclaration& decl = getParm(&child, ctx.scope(parmscope));
2024  // in Ada multiple parameters can be declared
2025  // within a single declaration.
2026  for (SgInitializedName* parm : decl.get_variables())
2027  lst.append_arg(parm);
2028  }
2029  }
2030  }
2031 }

2034 SgDeclarationStatement*
2035 queryDecl(ada_base_entity* lal_element, int defining_name_hash, AstContext /*ctx*/)
2036 {
2037  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
2038 
2039  ada_base_entity corresponding_decl;
2040  ada_expr_p_first_corresponding_decl(lal_element, &corresponding_decl);
2041  int decl_hash = 0;
2042  if(!ada_node_is_null(&corresponding_decl)){
2043  decl_hash = hash_node(&corresponding_decl);
2044  }
2045 
2046  SgDeclarationStatement* res = findFirst(libadalangDecls(), decl_hash, defining_name_hash);
2047 
2048  if((res == nullptr) && (kind == ada_identifier)){
2049  res = findFirst(adaPkgs(), decl_hash, defining_name_hash);
2050  }
2051 
2052  return res;
2053 }

2055 void handleStmt(ada_base_entity* lal_stmt, AstContext ctx, const std::string& lblname)
2056  {
2057  //~using PragmaContainer = AstContext::PragmaContainer;
2058 
2059  //Get the kind of this node
2060  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_stmt);
2061 
2062  LibadalangText kind_name(kind);
2063  std::string kind_name_string = kind_name.string_value();
2064  logTrace() << "handleStmt called on a " << kind_name_string << std::endl;
2065 
2066  SgStatement* assocstmt = nullptr;
2067  //Statement_Struct& stmt = elem.The_Union.Statement; //Same as lal_stmt now
2068  //ElemIdRange pragmaRange = idRange(stmt.Corresponding_Pragmas);
2069  //std::vector<Element_ID> pragmaVector;
2070 
2071  //std::copy(pragmaRange.first, pragmaRange.second, std::back_inserter(pragmaVector));
2072 
2073  switch(kind){
2074  case ada_null_stmt: // 5.1
2075  {
2076  logKind("ada_null_stmt", kind);
2077 
2078  SgNullStatement& sgnode = mkNullStatement();
2079 
2080  completeStmt(sgnode, lal_stmt, ctx);
2081 
2082  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2083  break;
2084  }
2085  case ada_assign_stmt: // 5.2
2086  {
2087  logKind("ada_assign_stmt", kind);
2088 
2089  //Get the destination & expr to assign
2090  ada_base_entity lal_dest, lal_expr;
2091  ada_assign_stmt_f_dest(lal_stmt, &lal_dest);
2092  ada_assign_stmt_f_expr(lal_stmt, &lal_expr);
2093 
2094  SgExpression& lhs = getExpr(&lal_dest, ctx);
2095  SgExpression& rhs = getExpr(&lal_expr, ctx);
2096  SgExprStatement& sgnode = mkAssignStmt(lhs, rhs);
2097  SgExpression& assign = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_expression());
2098 
2099  attachSourceLocation(assign, lal_stmt, ctx);
2100  completeStmt(sgnode, lal_stmt, ctx);
2101  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2102  break;
2103  }
2104  case ada_if_stmt: // 5.3
2105  {
2106  logKind("ada_if_stmt", kind);
2107 
2108  SgIfStmt& sgnode = mkIfStmt();
2109  SgIfStmt* ifStmt = &sgnode;
2110 
2111  completeStmt(sgnode, lal_stmt, ctx, lblname);
2112 
2113  //Get the first if stmt
2114  ada_base_entity lal_condition;
2115  ada_base_entity lal_path;
2116  ada_if_stmt_f_cond_expr(lal_stmt, &lal_condition);
2117  ada_if_stmt_f_then_stmts(lal_stmt, &lal_path);
2118  ifStmtConditionedBranch(&lal_condition, &lal_path, ifStmt, ctx);
2119 
2120  //Get any elsifs
2121  ada_base_entity lal_elsif_list;
2122  ada_if_stmt_f_alternatives(lal_stmt, &lal_elsif_list);
2123  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_elsif_list);
2124  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
2125  ada_base_entity lal_alternative;
2126  if(ada_node_child(&lal_elsif_list, i, &lal_alternative) != 0){
2127  ada_elsif_stmt_part_f_cond_expr(&lal_alternative, &lal_condition);
2128  ada_elsif_stmt_part_f_stmts(&lal_alternative, &lal_path);
2129  SgIfStmt& cascadingIf = mkIfStmt(true /* elsif */);
2130 
2131  sg::linkParentChild( SG_DEREF(ifStmt),
2132  static_cast<SgStatement&>(cascadingIf),
2133  &SgIfStmt::set_false_body
2134  );
2135  ifStmt = &cascadingIf;
2136  ifStmtConditionedBranch(&lal_condition, &lal_path, ifStmt, ctx);
2137  }
2138  }
2139 
2140  //Get the else
2141  ada_if_stmt_f_else_stmts(lal_stmt, &lal_path);
2142  count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_path);
2143  if(count > 0){
2144  ifStmtCommonBranch(&lal_path, ifStmt, ctx, &SgIfStmt::set_false_body);
2145  }
2146 
2147  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2148  break;
2149  }
2150  case ada_case_stmt: // 5.4
2151  {
2152  logKind("ada_case_stmt", kind);
2153 
2154  //Get the case_expr
2155  ada_base_entity lal_case_expr;
2156  ada_case_stmt_f_expr(lal_stmt, &lal_case_expr);
2157 
2158  //Get the alternatives
2159  ada_base_entity lal_alternatives;
2160  ada_case_stmt_f_alternatives(lal_stmt, &lal_alternatives);
2161 
2162  SgExpression& caseexpr = getExpr(&lal_case_expr, ctx);
2163  SgBasicBlock& casebody = mkBasicBlock();
2164  SgSwitchStatement& sgnode = mkAdaCaseStmt(caseexpr, casebody);
2165 
2166  completeStmt(sgnode, lal_stmt, ctx, lblname);
2167 
2168  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_alternatives);
2169 
2170  //Handle each alternative
2171  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
2172  ada_base_entity lal_case_stmt_alternative;
2173  if(ada_node_child(&lal_alternatives, i, &lal_case_stmt_alternative) != 0){
2174  createCaseStmtPath(&lal_case_stmt_alternative, sgnode, ctx.scope(casebody));
2175  }
2176  }
2177 
2178  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2179  break;
2180  }
2181  case ada_named_stmt:
2182  {
2183  logKind("ada_named_stmt", kind);
2184  //Get the name
2185  ada_base_entity lal_decl;
2186  ada_named_stmt_f_decl(lal_stmt, &lal_decl);
2187  ada_named_stmt_decl_f_name(&lal_decl, &lal_decl);
2188  ada_defining_name_f_name(&lal_decl, &lal_decl);
2189  std::string label_name = canonical_text_as_string(&lal_decl);
2190 
2191  //Get the stmt
2192  ada_base_entity lal_named_stmt;
2193  ada_named_stmt_f_stmt(lal_stmt, &lal_named_stmt);
2194 
2195  //Call handleStmt on the substmt, passing in the name
2196  handleStmt(&lal_named_stmt, ctx, label_name);
2197 
2198  break;
2199  }
2200  case ada_while_loop_stmt: // 5.5
2201  {
2202  logKind("ada_while_loop_stmt", kind);
2203 
2204  //Get the spec
2205  ada_base_entity lal_spec;
2206  ada_base_loop_stmt_f_spec(lal_stmt, &lal_spec);
2207  ada_while_loop_spec_f_expr(&lal_spec, &lal_spec);
2208 
2209  //Get the stmts
2210  ada_base_entity lal_loop_stmt_list;
2211  ada_base_loop_stmt_f_stmts(lal_stmt, &lal_loop_stmt_list);
2212 
2213  SgExpression& cond = getExpr(&lal_spec, ctx);
2214  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
2215  SgWhileStmt& sgnode = mkWhileStmt(cond, block);
2216  int hash = hash_node(lal_stmt);
2217 
2218  completeStmt(sgnode, lal_stmt, ctx, lblname);
2219  recordNode(ctx.labelsAndLoops().libadalangLoops(), hash, sgnode);
2220 
2221  /*PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
2222  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
2223 
2224  traverseIDs(adaStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(block)});
2225  processAndPlacePragmas(stmt.Pragmas, { &block }, pragmaCtx); // pragmaCtx.scope(block) ?*/ //TODO Pragmas
2226  //Call handleStmt for each stmt in the loop
2227  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_loop_stmt_list);
2228  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
2229  ada_base_entity lal_loop_stmt;
2230  if(ada_node_child(&lal_loop_stmt_list, i, &lal_loop_stmt) != 0){
2231  handleStmt(&lal_loop_stmt, ctx.scope(block));
2232  }
2233  }
2234 
2235  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2236  break;
2237  }
2238  case ada_loop_stmt: // 5.5
2239  {
2240  logKind("ada_loop_stmt", kind);
2241 
2242  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
2243  SgAdaLoopStmt& sgnode = mkAdaLoopStmt(block);
2244 
2245  //Get the stmts
2246  ada_base_entity lal_loop_stmt_list;
2247  ada_base_loop_stmt_f_stmts(lal_stmt, &lal_loop_stmt_list);
2248 
2249  completeStmt(sgnode, lal_stmt, ctx, lblname);
2250 
2251  int hash = hash_node(lal_stmt);
2252  recordNode(ctx.labelsAndLoops().libadalangLoops(), hash, sgnode);
2253 
2254  /*PragmaContainer pendingPragmas;
2255  AstContext pragmaCtx = ctx.pragmas(pendingPragmas);
2256 
2257  traverseIDs(adaStmts, elemMap(), StmtCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(block)});
2258  processAndPlacePragmas(stmt.Pragmas, { &block }, pragmaCtx); // pragmaCtx.scope(block) ?*/ //TODO Pragmas
2259  //Call handleStmt for each stmt in the loop
2260  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_loop_stmt_list);
2261  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
2262  ada_base_entity lal_loop_stmt;
2263  if(ada_node_child(&lal_loop_stmt_list, i, &lal_loop_stmt) != 0){
2264  handleStmt(&lal_loop_stmt, ctx.scope(block));
2265  }
2266  }
2267 
2268  assocstmt = &sgnode;
2269  break;
2270  }
2271  case ada_for_loop_stmt: // 5.5
2272  {
2273  logKind("ada_for_loop_stmt", kind);
2274 
2275  SgBasicBlock& block = mkBasicBlock();
2276  SgForStatement& sgnode = mkForStatement(block);
2277 
2278  //Get the for loop's iter var
2279  ada_base_entity lal_loop_spec, lal_for_var;
2280  ada_base_loop_stmt_f_spec(lal_stmt, &lal_loop_spec);
2281  ada_for_loop_spec_f_var_decl(&lal_loop_spec, &lal_for_var);
2282 
2283  //Get the direction of this loop
2284  ada_base_entity lal_has_reverse;
2285  ada_for_loop_spec_f_has_reverse(&lal_loop_spec, &lal_has_reverse);
2286  ada_node_kind_enum lal_has_reverse_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_reverse);
2287  bool isForwardLoop = (lal_has_reverse_kind == ada_reverse_absent);
2288 
2289  //Get the stmts
2290  ada_base_entity lal_loop_stmt_list;
2291  ada_base_loop_stmt_f_stmts(lal_stmt, &lal_loop_stmt_list);
2292 
2293  SgForInitStatement& forini = SG_DEREF( sb::buildForInitStatement(sgnode.getStatementList()) );
2294 
2295  attachSourceLocation(forini, &lal_for_var, ctx);
2296  sg::linkParentChild(sgnode, forini, &SgForStatement::set_for_init_stmt);
2297  completeStmt(sgnode, lal_stmt, ctx, lblname);

2804  void handleExceptionHandler(ada_base_entity* lal_element, SgTryStmt& tryStmt, AstContext ctx)
2805  {

2850 
2851  traverseIDs(range, elemMap(), StmtCreator{pragmaCtx.scope(body)});*/ //TODO Pragmas

2855  ada_base_entity lal_stmt;

2857  handleStmt(&lal_stmt, ctx.scope(body));

2861  computeSourceRangeFromChildren(body);

4320 
4321  //spec.second(std::move(taskPragmas)); // complete the body

4326  case ada_entry_decl: // 9.5.2(2)

4362  case ada_object_decl:

4368  ada_object_decl_f_has_constant(lal_element, &lal_has_constant);

4381  case ada_incomplete_tagged_type_decl: // 3.10.1(2)
4382  {
4383  logKind( kind == ada_incomplete_type_decl
4384  ? "ada_incomplete_type_decl"
4385  : "ada_incomplete_tagged_type_decl"
4386  , kind
4387  );

4390  ada_base_entity lal_full_decl;
4391  ada_base_type_decl_p_full_view(lal_element, &lal_full_decl);
4392 
4393  if(!ada_node_is_null(&lal_full_decl)){
4394  // \todo handle pragmas in opaque types

4396  }
4397  else
4398  {
4399  // no definition is available, ... (e.g., in System)
4400  //Get the name for this type
4401  ada_base_entity lal_identifier, lal_defining_name;
4402  ada_base_type_decl_f_name(lal_element, &lal_defining_name);
4403  ada_defining_name_f_name(&lal_defining_name, &lal_identifier);
4404

4409  int hash = hash_node(&lal_defining_name);
4410 
4411  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
4412  privatize(sgnode, isPrivate);
4413  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4414  recordNode(libadalangTypes(), hash, sgnode);
4415  assocdecl = &sgnode;
4416  }
4417 
4418  break;
4419  }
4420  case ada_type_decl: //3.2.1(3)
4421  {
4422  logKind("ada_type_decl", kind);
4423  //Get the type definition
4424  ada_base_entity lal_type_def;
4425  ada_type_decl_f_type_def(lal_element, &lal_type_def);
4426 
4427  ada_node_kind_enum type_def_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_type_def);
4428 
4429  logTrace() << "Ordinary Type\n";
4430 
4431  bool has_with_private = false;
4432 
4433  //Get/print abstract, limited, & private if possible
4434  if(type_def_kind == ada_derived_type_def){
4435  ada_base_entity lal_has_abstract;
4436  ada_derived_type_def_f_has_abstract(&lal_type_def, &lal_has_abstract);
4437  ada_node_kind_enum abstract_status = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_abstract);
4438  const bool has_abstract = (abstract_status == ada_abstract_present);
4439 
4440  ada_base_entity lal_has_limited;
4441  ada_derived_type_def_f_has_limited(&lal_type_def, &lal_has_limited);
4442  ada_node_kind_enum limited_status = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_limited);
4443  const bool has_limited = (limited_status == ada_limited_present);
4444 
4445  ada_base_entity lal_has_with_private;
4446  ada_derived_type_def_f_has_with_private(&lal_type_def, &lal_has_with_private);
4447  ada_node_kind_enum lal_has_with_private_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_with_private);
4448  if(lal_has_with_private_kind == ada_with_private_present){
4449  has_with_private = true;
4450  }
4451 
4452  logTrace() << " abstract: " << has_abstract
4453  << "\n limited: " << has_limited
4454  << "\n private: " << has_with_private
4455  << std::endl;
4456  } else if (type_def_kind == ada_private_type_def){
4457  has_with_private = true;
4458 
4459  ada_base_entity lal_has_abstract;
4460  ada_private_type_def_f_has_abstract(&lal_type_def, &lal_has_abstract);
4461  ada_node_kind_enum abstract_status = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_abstract);
4462  const bool has_abstract = (abstract_status == ada_abstract_present);
4463 
4464  ada_base_entity lal_has_limited;
4465  ada_private_type_def_f_has_limited(&lal_type_def, &lal_has_limited);
4466  ada_node_kind_enum limited_status = ada_node_kind(&lal_has_limited);
4467  const bool has_limited = (limited_status == ada_limited_present);
4468 
4469  logTrace() << " abstract: " << has_abstract
4470  << "\n limited: " << has_limited
4471  << "\n private: " << has_with_private
4472  << std::endl;
4473  }
4474 
4475  //If it matches A_Private_Extension_Declaration/A_Private_Type_Declaration from ASIS, do this instead
4476  if(has_with_private){
4477  assocdecl = &handleOpaqueTypes(lal_element, isPrivate, ctx);
4478  break;
4479  }
4480 
4481  //Get the name of the type
4482  ada_base_entity lal_defining_name, lal_identifier;
4483  ada_base_type_decl_f_name(lal_element, &lal_defining_name);
4484  ada_defining_name_f_name(&lal_defining_name, &lal_identifier);
4485  std::string type_name = canonical_text_as_string(&lal_identifier);
4486  SgScopeStatement* parentScope = &ctx.scope();
4487  ada_base_entity lal_discr;
4488  ada_type_decl_f_discriminants(lal_element, &lal_discr);
4489  ada_base_entity* second_discr = secondaryDiscriminants(lal_element, &lal_discr, ctx);
4490  SgAdaDiscriminatedTypeDecl* discr = createDiscriminatedDecl_opt(&lal_discr, second_discr, ctx);
4491 
4492  //Get the previous part of this decl, if it exists
4493  ada_base_entity lal_previous_decl;
4494  ada_basic_decl_p_previous_part_for_decl(lal_element, 1, &lal_previous_decl); //TODO imprecise fallback
4495  SgDeclarationStatement* nondef = nullptr;
4496  if(!ada_node_is_null(&lal_previous_decl)){
4497  int previous_hash = hash_node(&lal_previous_decl);
4498  nondef = findFirst(libadalangTypes(), previous_hash);
4499  }
4500 
4501  if(discr)
4502  {
4503  parentScope = discr->get_discriminantScope();
4504  }
4505  SgScopeStatement& scope = SG_DEREF(parentScope);
4506  TypeData ty = getTypeFoundation(type_name, &lal_type_def, ctx.scope(scope));
4507  int type_hash = hash_node(lal_element);
4508  int name_hash = hash_node(&lal_defining_name);
4509  SgDeclarationStatement& sgdecl = sg::dispatch(TypeDeclMaker{type_name, scope, ty, nondef}, &ty.sageNode());
4510 
4511  privatize(sgdecl, isPrivate);
4512  //Record this type with hashes for both the ada_type_decl node and ada_defining_name node, since it may be searched for by either
4513  recordNode(libadalangTypes(), type_hash, sgdecl, nondef != nullptr);
4514  recordNode(libadalangTypes(), name_hash, sgdecl, nondef != nullptr);
4515  attachSourceLocation(sgdecl, lal_element, ctx);
4516 
4517  if (!discr)
4518  {
4519  //ADA_ASSERT(&ctx.scope() == parentScope);
4520  ctx.appendStatement(sgdecl);
4521 
4522  assocdecl = &sgdecl;
4523  }
4524  else
4525  {
4526  completeDiscriminatedDecl(type_hash, lal_element, *discr, sgdecl, isPrivate, ctx);
4527 
4528  assocdecl = discr;
4529  }
4530 
4531  processInheritedElementsOfDerivedTypes(ty, discr ? *discr : sgdecl, ctx);
4532 
4533  break;
4534  }
4535  default:
4536  logWarn() << "unhandled declaration kind: " << kind << std::endl;
4537  //ADA_ASSERT (!FAIL_ON_ERROR(ctx));
4538  }
4539 
4540  //processAspects(lal_element, decl, assocdecl, ctx);
4541  //recordPragmasID(std::move(pragmaVector), assocdecl, ctx);
4542 }

4545 void createVariant(ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx)
4546 {
4547  //Get the choices/components for this path
4548  ada_base_entity lal_choices, lal_components;
4549  ada_variant_f_choices(lal_element, &lal_choices);
4550 
4551  ada_variant_f_components(lal_element, &lal_components);
4552  ada_component_list_f_components(&lal_components, &lal_components);
4553 
4554  //Process the choices
4555  SgExpressionPtrList exprlst;
4556  int num_choices = ada_node_children_count(&lal_choices);
4557  for(int i = 0; i < num_choices; ++i){
4558  ada_base_entity lal_choice;
4559  if(ada_node_child(&lal_choices, i, &lal_choice) !=0){
4560  ada_node_kind_enum lal_choice_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_choice);
4561  if(lal_choice_kind == ada_bin_op || lal_choice_kind == ada_others_designator){
4562  exprlst.push_back(&getDefinitionExpr(&lal_choice, ctx));
4563  } else {
4564  exprlst.push_back(&getExpr(&lal_choice, ctx));
4565  }
4566  }
4567  }
4568 
4569  SgExprListExp& choicelst = mkExprListExp(exprlst);
4570  SgAdaVariantWhenStmt& sgnode = mkAdaVariantWhenStmt(choicelst);
4571  SgAdaUnscopedBlock& blk = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_components());
4572 
4573  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4574 
4575  //Handle the components
4576  int num_components = ada_node_children_count(&lal_components);
4577  for(int i = 0; i < num_components; ++i){
4578  ada_base_entity lal_component;
4579  if(ada_node_child(&lal_components, i, &lal_component) != 0){
4580  handleElement(&lal_component, ctx.unscopedBlock(blk));
4581  }
4582  }
4583 }

4585 //Searches the adaTypes map for a match to the hashes given, and returns the decl of the match if found
4586 SgDeclarationStatement* typeDeclarationFromStandard(int hash1, int hash2){
4587  SgType* res = findFirst(adaTypes(), hash1, hash2);
4588 
4589  if (SgNamedType* namedType = isSgNamedType(res)){
4590  return namedType->get_declaration();
4591  }
4592 
4593  return nullptr;
4594 }

4596 void findBaseName(ada_base_entity* lal_element, ada_base_entity& lal_return_name){
4597  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
4598  lal_return_name = *lal_element;
4599  if(kind == ada_attribute_ref){
4600  //If we have an attribute ref, get the prefix
4601  //The ada_attribute_ref should always be the top node of the tree, if it exists
4602  ada_attribute_ref_f_prefix(&lal_return_name, &lal_return_name);
4603  kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_return_name);
4604  }
4605  while(kind == ada_dotted_name){
4606  //If we have a chain of dotted_names, iterate until we find a leaf suffix
4607  ada_dotted_name_f_suffix(&lal_return_name, &lal_return_name);
4608  kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_return_name);
4609  }
4610 }

4613 bool useClauseFatalError(std::string name, AstContext ctx){
4614  logFatal() << "using unknown package/type: "
4615  << "'" << name << "': "
4616  << "\n in scope type: " << typeid(ctx.scope()).name()
4617  << std::endl;
4618 
4619  sg::report_error("using unknown package/type");

4623 void createUseClause(ada_base_entity* lal_element, map_t<int, SgDeclarationStatement*>& m, AstContext ctx){
4624  //Get the rightmost node for this name (get the suffix until we don't have ada_dotted_name)
4625  ada_base_entity lal_name;
4626  findBaseName(lal_element, lal_name);
4627 
4628  SgDeclarationStatement* used = nullptr;
4629  std::string full_name = getFullName(lal_element); //TODO This might break for some ada_use_type_clauses
4630 
4631  // Get the hash for the first declaration, and for the defining name of that declaration, if it exists
4632  ada_base_entity lal_first_decl;
4633  int decl_hash;
4634  int decl_name_hash;
4635  ada_expr_p_first_corresponding_decl(&lal_name, &lal_first_decl);
4636  if(ada_node_is_null(&lal_first_decl)){
4637  //Try p_referenced_decl
4638  ada_name_p_referenced_decl(&lal_name, 1, &lal_first_decl);
4639  }
4640  if(ada_node_is_null(&lal_first_decl)){
4641  decl_hash = 0; //Make sure decl_hash is undefined, even if we don't have a node
4642  decl_name_hash = 0;
4643  logFlaw() << "Could not find first decl for use clause!\n";
4644  } else {
4645  decl_hash = hash_node(&lal_first_decl);
4646  //Now get the defining_name node and hash it
4647  ada_base_entity lal_first_defining_name;
4648  //Get the kind of the decl
4649  ada_node_kind_enum decl_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_first_decl);
4650  if(decl_kind >= ada_generic_package_internal && decl_kind <= ada_package_decl){
4651  ada_base_package_decl_f_package_name(&lal_first_decl, &lal_first_defining_name);
4652  decl_name_hash = hash_node(&lal_first_defining_name);
4653  } else if(decl_kind >= ada_discrete_base_subtype_decl && decl_kind <= ada_synth_anonymous_type_decl){
4654  ada_base_type_decl_f_name(&lal_first_decl, &lal_first_defining_name);
4655  decl_name_hash = hash_node(&lal_first_defining_name);
4656  } else if(decl_kind == ada_package_renaming_decl){
4657  ada_package_renaming_decl_f_name(&lal_first_decl, &lal_first_defining_name);
4658  decl_name_hash = hash_node(&lal_first_defining_name);
4659  } else if(decl_kind == ada_generic_package_renaming_decl){
4660  ada_generic_package_renaming_decl_f_name(&lal_first_decl, &lal_first_defining_name);
4661  decl_name_hash = hash_node(&lal_first_defining_name);
4662  } else {
4663  logWarn() << "Could not find defining_name for decl kind " << decl_kind << " in createUseClause()\n";
4664  decl_name_hash = 0;
4665  }
4666  }
4667 
4668  (used != nullptr)
4669  || (used = findFirst(m, decl_hash, decl_name_hash))
4670  //|| (used = fromSymbolLookup(usedEl)) //TODO This searches based off name?
4671  || (used = findFirst(adaPkgs(), decl_hash, decl_name_hash))
4672  || (used = typeDeclarationFromStandard(decl_hash, decl_name_hash))
4673  || (useClauseFatalError(full_name, ctx))
4674  ;
4675 
4676  SgUsingDeclarationStatement& sgnode = mkUseClause(*used);
4677  std::size_t attrPos = full_name.find("'");
4678 
4679  if(attrPos != std::string::npos){
4680  // \todo introduce proper flag
4681  sgnode.set_adaTypeAttribute(full_name.substr(attrPos+1));
4682  }
4683 
4684  int hash = hash_node(lal_element);
4685  recordNode(libadalangDecls(), hash, sgnode);
4686  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
4687  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4688 }

4691 SgExpression& createWithClause(ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx){
4692  //Get the rightmost node for this name (get the suffix until we don't have ada_dotted_name)
4693  ada_base_entity lal_name;
4694  findBaseName(lal_element, lal_name);
4695 
4696  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
4697  while(kind == ada_dotted_name){
4698  ada_dotted_name_f_suffix(&lal_name, &lal_name);
4699  kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_name);
4700  }
4701 
4702  SgExpression& sgnode = getExpr(&lal_name, ctx);
4703 
4704  // store source location of the fully qualified name
4705  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
4706  return sgnode;
4707 }

4721 SgExpression& createEnumValue(ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx){
4722  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
4723  if(kind != ada_aggregate_assoc){
4724  logError() << "createEnumValue given node kind " << kind << " (not an ada_aggregate_assoc)!\n";
4725  return mkNullExpression();
4726  }
4727  logKind("ada_aggregate_assoc", kind);
4728 
4729  //Get the expr for this assoc
4730  ada_base_entity lal_expr;
4731  ada_aggregate_assoc_f_r_expr(lal_element, &lal_expr);
4732 
4733  //Get the list of designators for this assoc
4734  ada_base_entity lal_designator_list;
4735  ada_aggregate_assoc_f_designators(lal_element, &lal_designator_list);
4736 
4737  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_designator_list);
4738  //If there is more than one designator, something is wrong
4739  if(count > 1 || count < 0){
4740  logError() << "createEnumValue has " << count << " designators! Expected 0 or 1.\n";
4741  return mkNullExpression();
4742  }
4743 
4744  SgExpression& enumval = getExpr(&lal_expr, ctx);
4745  SgExpression& sgnode = count == 0
4746  ? enumval
4747  : itemValuePair(&lal_designator_list, enumval, ctx);
4748  ;
4749  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
4750  return sgnode;
4751 }

4754 void createComponentClause(ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx){
4755  ada_node_kind_enum kind = ada_node_kind(lal_element);
4756  if(kind != ada_component_clause){
4757  logError() << "createComponentClause given node kind " << kind << " (not an ada_component_clause)!\n";
4758  return;
4759  }
4760 
4761  logKind("ada_component_clause", kind);

4792 void handleClause(ada_base_entity* lal_element, AstContext ctx)

4817  implst.push_back(&createWithClause(&lal_with_name, ctx));
4818  }
4819  }
4820 
4821  SgImportStatement& sgnode = mkWithClause(std::move(implst));

4823 
4824  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
4825  recordNode(libadalangDecls(), hash, sgnode);
4826  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4827 
4828  //~ recordNonUniqueNode(libadalangDecls(), ???, sgnode);
4829 
4830  break;
4831  }
4832 
4833  case ada_use_type_clause: // 8.4
4834  case ada_use_package_clause: // 8.4
4835  {
4836  const bool typeClause = (kind == ada_use_type_clause);

4838  logKind(typeClause ? "ada_use_type_clause" : "ada_use_package_clause", kind);
4839

4842  if(kind == ada_use_type_clause){
4843  ada_use_type_clause_f_types(lal_element, &lal_name_list);
4844  } else {
4845  ada_use_package_clause_f_packages(lal_element, &lal_name_list);
4846  }
4847 
4848  //Call createUseClause on each node in the list
4849  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_name_list);
4850  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
4851  ada_base_entity lal_use_name;
4852  if(ada_node_child(&lal_name_list, i, &lal_use_name) != 0){
4853  createUseClause(&lal_use_name, typeClause ? libadalangTypes() : libadalangDecls(), ctx);
4854  }
4855  }
4856 
4857  break;
4858  }
4859  case ada_record_rep_clause: // 13.5.1
4860  {
4861  using SageRecordClause = SgAdaRepresentationClause;
4862 
4863  logKind("ada_record_rep_clause", kind);
4864 
4865  //Get the name of this clause
4866  ada_base_entity lal_name;
4867  ada_record_rep_clause_f_name(lal_element, &lal_name);
4868 
4869  //Get the mod of this clause
4870  ada_base_entity lal_mod;
4871  ada_record_rep_clause_f_at_expr(lal_element, &lal_mod);
4872 
4873  //Get the list of components for this clause

4876 
4877  SgType& tyrec = getDeclType(&lal_name, ctx);

4879  SageRecordClause& sgnode = mkAdaRepresentationClause(tyrec, modexp);
4880  SgBasicBlock& components = SG_DEREF(sgnode.get_components());
4881 
4882 
4883  // sgnode is not a decl: recordNode(asisDecls(), el.ID, sgnode);
4884  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
4885  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4886 
4887  //Traverse the components
4888  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_component_list);
4889  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
4890  ada_base_entity lal_component_clause;
4891  if(ada_node_child(&lal_component_list, i, &lal_component_clause) != 0){
4892  createComponentClause(&lal_component_clause, ctx.scope(components));

4894  }

4896  /*PragmaContainer pendingPragmas; //TODO Pragmas

4900 
4901  processAndPlacePragmas(repclause.Pragmas, { &components }, pragmaCtx.scope(components));*/
4902 
4903  break;
4904  }
4905  case ada_at_clause: // J.7
4906  {
4907  using SageRecordClause = SgAdaRepresentationClause;
4908 
4909  logKind("ada_at_clause", kind);
4910 
4911  //Get the name for this clause
4912  ada_base_entity lal_name;

4914 
4915  //Get the expr for this clause
4916  ada_base_entity lal_expr;
4917  ada_at_clause_f_expr(lal_element, &lal_expr);
4918 
4919  // \todo Representation_Clause_Name may not refer to a type but to a variable
4920  // (e.g.,rep_sys_address.adb)
4921  // consider using expressions as base for AdaRepresentationClause...
4922  SgType& ty = getDeclType(&lal_name, ctx);
4923  SgExpression& modexp = getExpr_opt(&lal_expr, ctx);
4924  SageRecordClause& sgnode = mkAdaRepresentationClause(ty, modexp, true /* at-clause */);
4925 
4926  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);
4927  ctx.appendStatement(sgnode);
4928 
4929  break;
4930  }
4931  case ada_attribute_def_clause: // 13.3
4932  {
4933  logKind("ada_attribute_def_clause", kind);
4934 
4935  //Get the attribute & expr for this clause
4936  ada_base_entity lal_attribute, lal_expr;
4937  ada_attribute_def_clause_f_attribute_expr(lal_element, &lal_attribute);
4938  ada_attribute_def_clause_f_expr(lal_element, &lal_expr);

4943 
4944  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);

4947  break;

4949  case ada_enum_rep_clause: // 13.4
4950  {
4951  logKind("ada_enum_rep_clause", kind);
4952 
4953  //Get the name for this clause
4954  ada_base_entity lal_name;
4955  ada_enum_rep_clause_f_type_name(lal_element, &lal_name);
4956 
4957  //Get the list of associations
4958  ada_base_entity lal_assoc_list;
4959  ada_enum_rep_clause_f_aggregate(lal_element, &lal_assoc_list);
4960  ada_base_aggregate_f_assocs(&lal_assoc_list, &lal_assoc_list);
4961  std::vector<SgExpression*> assocs;
4962  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_assoc_list);
4963  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
4964  ada_base_entity lal_assoc;
4965  if(ada_node_child(&lal_assoc_list, i, &lal_assoc) != 0){
4966  assocs.push_back(&createEnumValue(&lal_assoc, ctx));

4970  SgType& enumty = getDeclType(&lal_name, ctx);

4973 
4974  attachSourceLocation(sgnode, lal_element, ctx);

5039 void
5040 processInheritedSubroutines( SgNamedType& derivedType,
5041  ada_base_entity* tydef,
5042  AstContext ctx
5043  )
5044 {
5045  ada_base_entity lal_tydef_deref = *tydef;
5046  // use a deferred unit completion, so that all information of records
5047  // (i.e., detailed inheritance relationship) have been seen when
5048  // the inherited subroutines are processed.
5049  auto deferredSubRoutineProcessing =
5050  [&derivedType, lal_tydef_deref, ctx]() -> void
5051  {
5052  SgType* baseType = si::Ada::baseType(derivedType);
5053  SgType* baseRootRaw = si::Ada::typeRoot(baseType).typerep();
5054  SgNamedType* baseRootType = isSgNamedType(baseRootRaw);
5055 
5056  if (baseRootType == nullptr)
5057  {
5058  // if baseRootRaw != nullptr
5059  // it will correspond to a universal type in package standard.
5060  // -> not an error
5061  if (baseRootRaw == nullptr)
5062  logFlaw() << "unable to find any base-root for " << derivedType.get_name()
5063  << " / base = " << baseType
5064  << std::endl;
5065  return;
5066  }
5067 
5068  //~ logWarn() << "drv: " << derivedType.get_name() << " / " << baseRootType->get_name()
5069  //~ << std::endl;
5070  //Figure out what the subprograms to inherit are
5071  //Get the original type
5072  ada_base_entity lal_tydef = lal_tydef_deref;
5073  ada_base_entity lal_super_type;
5074  ada_derived_type_def_f_subtype_indication(&lal_tydef, &lal_super_type);
5075  ada_type_expr_p_designated_type_decl(&lal_super_type, &lal_super_type);
5076 
5077  // Get the programs that use the original type
5078  //Get the name of the type
5079  ada_text_type lal_unique_identifying_name;
5080  ada_basic_decl_p_unique_identifying_name(&lal_super_type, &lal_unique_identifying_name);
5081  std::string unique_identifying_name = dot_ada_text_type_to_string(lal_unique_identifying_name);
5082 
5083  ada_base_entity lal_node_list;
5084  ada_ada_node_parent(&lal_super_type, &lal_node_list);
5085  int count = ada_node_children_count(&lal_node_list);
5086  for(int i = 0; i < count; ++i){
5087  ada_base_entity lal_stmt;
5088  if(ada_node_child(&lal_node_list, i, &lal_stmt) != 0){
5089  //Check if this is a subp_decl that uses the original type
5090  ada_node_kind_enum lal_stmt_kind = ada_node_kind(&lal_stmt);
5091  if(lal_stmt_kind == ada_subp_decl){
5092  ada_text_type lal_subp_unique_name;
5093  ada_basic_decl_p_unique_identifying_name(&lal_stmt, &lal_subp_unique_name);
5094  std::string subp_unique_name = dot_ada_text_type_to_string(lal_subp_unique_name);
5095  if(subp_unique_name.find(unique_identifying_name) != std::string::npos){
5096  createInheritedSymbol(&lal_stmt, *baseRootType, derivedType, ctx);
5097  }
5098  }
5099  }
5100  }
5101 
5102  /*if (!declarations.empty()) //TODO decls? Can decls be inherited?
5103  {
5104  // fields will be added later during the fixup pass: FixupAstSymbolTablesToSupportAliasedSymbols
5105  // \todo also implement fixup for discriminants and enumerations..
5106  logInfo() << "A derived/extension record type's implicit declaration is not empty: "
5107  << derivedType.get_name()
5108  << std::endl;
5109  }*/
5110  };
5111 
5112  ctx.storeDeferredUnitCompletion(std::move(deferredSubRoutineProcessing));
5113 }
